title: Senior Backend Engineer, Finance Automation
description_clean: Ramp is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build the automation core of our finance platform. You will design high-throughput ledger services, own data integrity end to end, and partner with product to ship customer-facing automation. Requirements: 5+ years of backend experience, strong Python, production experience with relational databases, and a track record of operating services you built. Nice to have: event streaming (Kafka), workflow orchestration (Airflow), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).

core_responsibilities: Design and operate ledger services processing millions of daily transactions
Own data integrity, idempotency, and reconciliation guarantees
Partner with product on finance automation features
Mentor mid-level engineers through design review
parsed.summary_mission: Build the automation core that replaces manual finance back-office work for SMBs.
